summary: PR-C (50ff5fc) closed prior GIS-001 (agent.md high_risk_globs path map) and GIS-002 (CROSS_VALIDATE_TOL_M doc drift). Karney geodesic, Sutherland-Hodgman convex clip, multi-source DEM cross-validation, terrain cache quantization, and per-radial ring closure all check out at HEAD 50ff5fc. One new LOW finding (GIS-003): the /static/counties-10m.json endpoint is served by the map sidecar's server.js but is never fetched by render.html.

findings.title: RESOLVED — agent.md high_risk_globs corrected to engine/geometry/** + polygonOverlap.js
findings.recommended_fix: No action — closure record. PR-C replaced nonexistent paths 'genoa/src/engine/geodesy/**' and 'genoa/src/engine/coverage/polygon_clip.js' with the actual 'genoa/src/engine/geometry/**' and 'genoa/src/engine/geometry/polygonOverlap.js'.

findings.title: RESOLVED — agent.md aligned to CROSS_VALIDATE_TOL_M (30 m, exported from elevationClient.js)
findings.recommended_fix: No action — closure record. PR-C aligned the checklist text to cite CROSS_VALIDATE_TOL_M as the exported symbol (30 m) rather than restating a divergent number.

findings.title: Map sidecar serves /static/counties-10m.json but render.html never fetches it
findings.recommended_fix: Either (a) wire counties-10m into render.html alongside states-10m so the agent.md checklist item 6 ('counties-10m render') has actual evidence, or (b) drop the endpoint at server.js:91-94 and remove the counties claim from agent.md so the map-sidecar deliverable matches what's documented. Either fix is <30 LOC and deploy-risk low.
tests_required: grep -F 'counties-10m' genoa/src/sidecars/map/render.html  # must return >=1 line if endpoint stays
OR grep -nF '/static/counties-10m.json' genoa/src/sidecars/map/server.js  # must return 0 if endpoint dropped
findings.reproducibility_notes: git log --follow genoa/src/sidecars/map/render.html shows the file has never contained the string 'counties'. server.js:91-94 advertises the endpoint.
